overall_assessment: NMH reliably captures learning outcomes and the main assessment and coursework blocks, while assessment logistics persist in suspects and random controls and some substantive text follows the wrong heading. The coursework leakage flags identify mandatory practice assigned to teaching and practice, and both .drop flags identify admissions text in course content, including a genuine prerequisite for ENSLED22. The CBE boilerplate flags reflect substantive text repeated across offerings, with incidental admin in course content, and the other leakage flags match legitimate essay or portfolio instructions, a line-wrapped module topic, or an outcomes cross-reference.

findings.evidence:
Deltagelse i praksisaktiviteter er obligatorisk. Studenten skal delta i minst ett dirigeringsprosjekt med kor.
Arbeidskrav for de enkelte delemnene fastsettes i semesterplan.
findings.description: In both Dirigeringsstudier offerings the coursework leakage flags are real. The Praksis subheading is inside Arbeidskrav. Its mandatory participation and project requirement and the following semester-plan note land in teaching methods and practice, leaving coursework requirements with only the general approval gate. The paragraph on work with rehearsal ensembles under Organisering correctly appears in teaching methods. The repeated text in teaching and practice arises from the overlay, while the error is assigning exam gates to either row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In R/extract_sections.R, sectionize() lets the generic Praksis subheading mapping override the coursework parent and starts the practice overlay without checking the parent or the block's mandatory-work wording.
findings.suggested_fix: When an NMH Praksis subheading is nested under Arbeidskrav and opens with an explicit mandatory-participation requirement, retain the block in coursework_requirements and suppress the practice overlay for the requirement. Leave practicum descriptions under teaching headings eligible for the overlay.

findings.evidence: Opptakskrav: 120 stp. høyere utdanning innen musikk, gjennomført Ensembleledelse I eller tilsvarende og bestått opptaksprøve.
findings.description: The .drop flag catches a mixed admissions statement in course content. It contains explicit prior music study and completion of Ensembleledelse I or equivalent, with no prerequisites row. The preceding sentence also identifies Ensembleledelse I or equivalent as prior preparation.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The inline Opptakskrav label bypasses the NMH admission route, and the NMH builds-on sentence rule in R/extract_sections.R expects a coded course reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Send stand-alone NMH body lines starting with Opptakskrav: through the substantive-prerequisite filter. Preserve the full mixed sentence when it names quantified prior music study or a completed prior course, and allow an explicit named course followed by eller tilsvarende in the builds-on rule.

findings.evidence: Pensum: Omtrent 1000 sider felles pensum som oppgis av faglærer.
findings.description: The unflagged MPTEO73 control has a substantive common reading-load note under Innhold. The note remains in course content and no reading-list row is emitted. Other plans capture comparable syllabus notes from summary fields or their own headings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NMH section_label_selector in R/institution_config.R covers the introductory summary list and misses the inline label in the rich-text body.
findings.suggested_fix: Route a separate NMH body paragraph anchored on Pensum: with a substantive value into reading_list, removing it from the enclosing section. Require the exact colon-delimited label so instructions about essay sources and portfolio components retain their assessment role.

findings.evidence: Det vil også bli gitt forelesninger og demonstrasjoner av ulike komponisters, musikere og lydkunstneres arbeid og tenkning.
findings.description: The prose under Kort om emnet and Innhold can mix topics with substantive teaching and assessment details. The EXCOM20 control keeps lectures, demonstrations, collaborative projects and supervision in course content. CBE keeps how the projects are scheduled there, and KPKUNST70 retains a sentence specifying that documentation from the two projects contributes to final assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: NMH section headings correctly open course-content blocks, but the institution-specific sentence moves in R/extract_sections.R lack rules for these embedded teaching and graded-work statements.
findings.suggested_fix: Add NMH sentence moves from course_content to teaching_methods for explicit delivery statements such as Det vil bli gitt forelesninger, Det vil gis veiledning and Emnet er prosjektbasert with its adjoining project-delivery detail. Route the project-documentation sentence with inngår som en del av avsluttende vurdering to assessment. Keep the surrounding topic statements and approval wording in their appropriate roles.

findings.evidence: Frist: Innen 10. juni leveres rapporten i NMHs digitale eksamenssystem (Inspera). Les mer på vår informasjonsside om eksamensinnlevering.
findings.description: Both suspects and random controls retain exam logistics in otherwise usable assessment rows. Examples include Inspera and Canvas submission instructions, embedded submission dates, venue and semester details, examiner arrangements and rules requiring a repeat of the course after failure. Written-report lengths, concert durations, the criteria for the exam and the grading scales are assessment design.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NMH and generic cleanup patterns in R/extract_sections.R handle a stock same-arrangement resit sentence but miss these stand-alone and inline logistical variants.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply assessment-only cleanup to standalone submission deadlines, exam-system and venue instructions, examiner assignments and repeat-course notices. Strip bounded clauses such as parenthetical frist dates or exam-semester phrases within substantive sentences, retaining the assessment components and design. Remove labels left empty after cleanup.

findings.evidence: Opptak til emnet forutsetter at deltagerne kan utgjøre et funksjonsdyktig ensemble.
findings.description: The IMPRO27 .drop flag identifies an enrollment condition based on assembling a viable group. CBE and the KOMP26 control retain enrollment instructions or pointers in course content. ORGEL21 retains course-combination restrictions, a responsibility line and an outcomes pointer. Similar administrative references survive in other rows, including the progression pointer in Dirigeringsstudier teaching methods and Se studieplan in the ENSLED22 assessment summary.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading map can drop recognized administrative headings, but NMH body sentences and labeled summary values with these wording variants can pass through .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Extend NMH cleanup with anchored rules for ensemble-formation admission conditions, application deadlines and pointers, responsibility or teacher stubs, standalone course-combination restrictions, progression pointers and pointer-only summary values. Retain sentences that name substantive prerequisites and retain concrete course, teaching and assessment information.
